sbh3.0:1.1: evaṁ kṛte pudgalavyavasthāne, ālambanavyavasthāne, yāvadbhāvanāphalavyavasthāne ātmakāmena pudgalena svārthamanuprāptukāmena ādikarmikena ṇa |
sbh3.0:1.2: tatprathamakarmikena ṇa yogajña, ācāryo vā, upādhyāyo vā, puruṣo, gurusthānīyo vā, caturṣu sthāneṣu smṛtimupasthāpya upasaṁkramitavyaḥ |
sbh3.0:1.7: na lābhasatkārārthamevaṁ ca punarupasaṁkramya kālenāvakāśaṁ kṛtvā, ekāṁsamuttarāsaṁgaṁ kṛtvā, dakṣiṇaṁ jānumaṇḍalaṁ pṛthivyāṁ pratiṣṭhāpya, nīcataramevāsane niṣadya, sapratīśena yoga āyācitavyaḥ |
sbh3.0:1.9: ityevañca punarāyācitena yoginā yogajñena sa ādikarmikaḥ, tatprathamakarmikaḥ yogamanasikāre prayoktukāmaḥ |
sbh3.0:1.13: sādhu, sādhu, durmukha, yastvāṁ stvaṁ pramādāpagatāyāṁ prajāyāṁ, viṣayanimnāyāṁ, viṣayādhyavasitāyāṁ apramādāya prayoktukāmaḥ |
sbh3.0:1.30: parahitāya, bahujanahitāya, lokānukampāyai, arthāya, hitāya, sukhāya devamanuṣyāṇāmityevaṁbhāgīyaiḥ ślakṣṇairvacanapathaiḥ |
sbh3.0:1.31: saṁharṣayitvā saṁharṣya prahāṇe cānuśaṁsaṁ darśayitvā, caturṣu paripṛcchāsthānīyeṣu dharmeṣu paripraṣṭavyaḥ |
sbh3.0:1.32: kaści cci dāyuṣmānekāntena buddhaśaraṇaṁ gato, dharmaṁ, saṁghaṁ, no cetobahirdhānyaṁ śāstāraṁ vā, dakṣiṇīyamvā saṁjānāti, kaccitte ādipariśodhitādbrahmacaryasya bhāvanāyai śīlaṁ ca te saviśuddhaṁ, dṛṣṭiśca ṛjvī kaccitte āryasatyānāmuddeśavibhaṁgamāramya dharmaḥ śrutaścodgṛhītaśca | alpo vā, prabhūto vā, kaccitte nirvāṇādhimuktaṁ cittaṁ | nirvāṇābhiprāyaśca pravrajitaḥ |
sbh3.0:1.34: tata uttari caturṣu sthāneṣu caturbhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ samanveṣitavyaḥ |
sbh3.0:1.37: caritataśca samanveṣitavyaḥ kathayā, ceṣṭayā, cetaḥ paryāyasthānena paryeṣitavyaḥ |
sbh3.0:1.50: kīdṛśāni me indriyāṇi mṛdūni, madhyāni, tīkṣṇāni, kiṁ rāgacaritaḥ |
sbh3.0:1.54: pū pau rvāparyeṇa cāmuno gotramindriyaṁ, caritañcopalakṣitaṁ bhavati |
sbh3.0:1.61: tasya tata uttarakālaṁ kathayā tāvattrīṇi samanveṣitavyāni |
sbh3.0:1.63: citrairgamakaidhurairvacanapathaiḥsa tasyāṁ kathāyāṁ kathyamānāyāṁ sa cecchrāvakagotro bhavatyatyarthaṁ tayā kathayā prīyate |
sbh3.0:1.66: mahāyānapratisaṁyuktāyāmvā punaḥ kathāyāṁ kathyamānāyāṁ yo mahāyānagotraḥ so ’tyarthaṁ prīyate |
sbh3.0:1.78: sa prasadanīyāyāṁ kathāyāṁ kathyamānāyā matyarthaṁ prasīdati ramate |
sbh3.0:1.79: kā yā va ta d dhyānaṁ praviśati |
sbh3.0:1.80: cāptā ca magru aśru prapātaṁ ca snigdhasantānatāṁ, mṛducittatāṁ, dravacittatāṁ copadarśayati |
sbh3.0:1.82: nirvedhikāyāṁ kathāyāṁ kathyamānāyāṁ nirvāṇapratisaṁyuktāyāṁ nirāmiṣamu t trasya saṁtrāsamāpadyate |
sbh3.0:1.94: na puna ḥ kaya tha yā paripṛcchana kaśca bhavati |
sbh3.0:1.99: śrāvakagotrasya, rāgacaritānāṁ ca pudgalānāṁ tāni ceṣṭetyucyate |
sbh3.0:1.100: tayā ca ceṣṭayā yathāyogaṁ gotramindriyaṁ caritaṁ ca samanveṣitavyaṁ |
sbh3.0:1.102: yathāpi sa yogī yogajño lābhī bhavati cetaḥ paryāyajñānasya |
sbh3.0:1.103: sa tena paracittajñānena gotramindriyaṁ, caritaṁ ca yathābhūtaṁ prajānāti |
sbh3.0:1.104: etāni catvāri sthānānyebhiścaturbhiḥ kāraṇaissamanveṣya pañcasu sthāneṣu vinayate |
sbh3.0:1.105: tadyathā samādhisaṁbhārarakṣopacaye, prāvivekye, cittaikāgratāyāḥ yāṁ , āvaraṇaviśuddhau, manaskārabhāvanāyāṁ ca |
sbh3.0:1.106: tatra samādhisaṁbhārarakṣopacayaḥ yāvatā śīlasamvareṇa samanvāgato bhavati |
sbh3.0:1.107: tatra cāpramādavihārī bhavatyapapariṇāya buddhānuśiṣṭasya ca buddhānujñātasya pudgalasya, śīlaskandhasya śikśāpadapratipattyā vīryaṁ na sransa sraṁsa yati |
sbh3.0:1.110: yathā śīlasamvara evamindriyasamvaraḥ, bhojane mātrajñatā, pūrvarātrāpararātraṁ jāgarikānuyogaḥ, saṁprajānadvihāritā, evaṁ yāvacchramaṇālaṁkāra iti |
sbh3.0:1.111: yasya yasya saṁbhāraparigṛhītasya dharmapravibhāgasya lābhī bhavati |
sbh3.0:1.112: sa taṁ vā rakṣatyuttari raṁ ca pravibhāgasya pāripūraye |
sbh3.0:1.113: yathoktādbhūrādhikakasamudācārāya c chandajāto viherayu ret mu mū kajāta ārubdhavīryaścāyamucyate samādhisaṁbhārarakṣopacayaḥ |
sbh3.0:1.114: sa evaṁ hānabhāgīyāṁśca dharmān virajyati, śeṣabhāgīyāṁśca dharmān pratiṣevamāṇaḥ praviviktavihārī bhavati |
sbh3.0:1.118: araṇyamvā, vṛkṣamūlamvā, śūnyāgāramvā-tatra parvatakandaraṁ vā, giriguhā vā, palālapuṁjāni vā śūnyāgāramityucyate |
sbh3.0:1.125: darśanīyaṁ prāsādikamārāmasampannaṁ, vanasampannaṁ, puṣkariṇīsampannaṁ, śubhaṁ, ramaṇīyaṁ, notkūlanikūlaṁ, na sthāṇukaṇṭakadhānaṁ |
sbh3.0:1.132: punarayaṁ ridaṁ na divā alpavilokaṁ bhavati |
sbh3.0:1.138: punaraparaṁ ye te ānulomikā jīvitapariṣkārāścī varādayaḥ |
sbh3.0:1.145: gaṁbhīraṁ cārthapadaṁ prajñayā pratividhya suṣṭhu ca prakāśayanti |
sbh3.0:1.150: niṣadya yāvatā evaṁ rātryāḥ prathamaṁ yāmaṁ, madhyame na ca yāme dakṣiṇena pārśvena ṇa śayyāṁ kalpayati |
sbh3.0:1.153: tasminnidaṁ sampanne śayanāsane, tathā buddhānujñāte mañce vā, pīṭhe vā, tṛṇe vā, saṁstaraṇe vā niṣīdati |
sbh3.0:1.155: kena kāraṇena pañca kāraṇāni samanupaśyan saṁpiṇḍitena kāyena praśrabdhirutpadyate |
sbh3.0:1.157: tathā cārikā kā laṁ niṣadyayāśakto vyatināmayituṁ |
sbh3.0:1.161: tathā pare aneneryāpathena niṣaṇṇaṁ dṛṣṭvā atyarthamabhiprasīdanti buddhaiśca buddhaśrāvakaiścāyaṁ īryāpatho niṣevitaścānujñātaśca |
sbh3.0:1.168: tatra ṛjunā kāyena pragṛhītena styānamiddhaṁ cittaṁ na paryādāya tiṣṭhati |
sbh3.0:1.169: niṣkuhakena citte bahirdhā vikṣepo na paryādāya tiṣṭhati |
sbh3.0:1.172: yāmupasthāpayati yoniśo manasikārasaṁprayuktā smṛtiḥ pra ti mukhe khī tyucyate |
sbh3.0:1.174: api ca samādhinimittālambanā pratibhālambanā smṛtiḥ pratimukhe khī tyucyate |
sbh3.0:2.1: tatra cittavyapakarṣaḥ yaḥ kliṣṭamavyākṛtaṁ ca manaskāraṁ ca varjayitvā |
sbh3.0:2.2: samāhitabhūmikaṁ vā samādhisaṁbhāraprāyogikaṁ vā manaskāraṁ bhāvayati |
sbh3.0:2.14: ye dharmā udgṛhītā ḥ śrutā, yā cāvavādānuśāsanī pratilabdhā bhavati |
sbh3.0:2.15: gurubhyastāmadhipatiṁ kṛtvā samāhitabhūmikanimittaṁ saṁmukhīkṛtya tadālambanāṁ pravāhayuktāṁ smṛtimanuvarttayati |
sbh3.0:2.26: yā punarabhikṣayākārānichidrā niśchidrā nirantarā smṛtiḥ pravartate |
sbh3.0:2.27: tenālambanena satataṁ ca satkṛtya ceyaṁ pravāhayuktatā |
